item.title: Self-Hosted IP-KVM Solutions: PiKVM vs TinyPilot vs BliKVM
item.description: Managing bare-metal servers remotely requires out-of-band access — the ability to control a machine even when its operating system is unresponsive. IP-KVM (IP-based Keyboard-Video-Mouse) solutions provide remote console access by capturing video output and injecting keyboard/mouse input over the network. This guide compares three popular open-source IP-KVM platforms: PiKVM, TinyPilot, and BliKVM.
